name: AI Upscaler Plugin
overview: AI-Powered Video Upscaling Plugin with Docker Microservice Architecture
description: Video upscaling through an external AI service, with client-side scaling and optional object masking. Backend and model availability depend on the installed image and hardware. HDR processing is limited to single PQ/BT.2020 RGB16 frames; target-hardware validation is required.
changelog: v1.8.3.35: The player button no longer needs write access to Jellyfin's web folder. The plugin adds its script to index.html as Jellyfin serves the page, so Windows installs (NetworkService), the Debian package, snaps and read-only containers get the button in every browser tab. Behind a Jellyfin base URL, the Lanczos, Anime4K and WebGPU real-time engines load again. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer. Target-hardware playback, GPU and HDR acceptance remain unverified.
